signal: Reggora raised $18M from Centana Growth in September 2025 to roll out its 24-hour appraisal product and acquired virtual-inspection company Appreeze in early 2026.

email.body1:
Haley, saw Reggora raised $18M and acquired Appreeze to push your 24-hour appraisal product.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market lenders than a sales team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Reggora off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Haley, quick follow-up for Reggora.

Post-raise and post-acquisition, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Reggora needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Haley, last bit of proof for Reggora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reggora's reply rate likely compares to other mortgage-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Haley, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch after a raise and an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Reggora either way.
